briefdescription.para: Suppresses compiler warnings about an unreferenced function parameter.

detaileddescription.para: Casts x to void so that compilers do not emit an unused-parameter diagnostic. Use this in function bodies where a parameter is intentionally left unused (e.g. in a no-op override or a debug-only code path).

parameterdescription.para: The parameter name to mark as intentionally unused.

briefdescription.para: Deletes the copy constructor of TypeName.

detaileddescription.para: Place inside a class body to prevent copy construction. Typically used together with ONNX_DISALLOW_ASSIGNMENT.

parameterdescription.para: The unqualified name of the enclosing class.

briefdescription.para: Deletes the copy-assignment operator of TypeName.

detaileddescription.para: Place inside a class body to prevent copy assignment. Typically used together with ONNX_DISALLOW_COPY.

parameterdescription.para: The unqualified name of the enclosing class.

briefdescription.para: Deletes both the copy constructor and copy-assignment operator of TypeName.

detaileddescription.para: Expands to ONNX_DISALLOW_COPY followed by ONNX_DISALLOW_ASSIGNMENT, making the class non-copyable.

parameterdescription.para: The unqualified name of the enclosing class.

briefdescription.para: Deletes both the move constructor and move-assignment operator of TypeName.

detaileddescription.para: Place inside a class body to prevent move construction and move assignment, making the class immovable.

parameterdescription.para: The unqualified name of the enclosing class.

briefdescription.para: Deletes all copy and move special-member functions of TypeName.

detaileddescription.para: Expands to ONNX_DISALLOW_COPY_AND_ASSIGNMENT followed by ONNX_DISALLOW_MOVE, making the class neither copyable nor movable.

parameterdescription.para: The unqualified name of the enclosing class.

briefdescription.para: Portability macros for exception handling and class rule-of-five enforcement.

detaileddescription.para:
Provides two groups of macros:
Exception-handling macros (ONNX_THROW, ONNX_THROW_EX, ONNX_TRY, ONNX_CATCH, ONNX_HANDLE_EXCEPTION) that transparently switch between C++ exceptions and abort()-based termination depending on whether ONNX_NO_EXCEPTIONS is defined.
Copy/move-deletion macros (ONNX_DISALLOW_COPY, ONNX_DISALLOW_ASSIGNMENT, ONNX_DISALLOW_MOVE, ONNX_DISALLOW_COPY_AND_ASSIGNMENT, ONNX_DISALLOW_COPY_ASSIGNMENT_AND_MOVE) that delete the corresponding special-member functions in a class body.
